verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents an official MCP server for running browser automation tasks from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client (docs-12), and a probe confirms the dedicated guide page exists (probe-3). One older community comment says Cursor MCP integration was unavailable; it appears to predate this documented server and is not a hands-on failure of it, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: details on setup, auth, and exposed tools, plus independent hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
